title: A bakery
heading: A bakery
That opens at six
summary: An example: a bakery that opens at six, and a site that says when the bread runs out.

body.p: The bakery bakes one bread and does it well. Its site is just as plain: one colour, one typeface, three pages.
The site starts with the opening hours and works outward, to the menu and a [contact page](/contact) that says when the bread runs out.
